content.json:
## Jolt API
Custom metrics from `jolt/telemetry.py` (OpenTelemetry, `customMetrics`) and request telemetry (`requests`). Counters are exported as deltas, so `sum(valueSum)` is the count; histograms carry `valueSum` / `valueCount` per export interval.

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.sync.runs"
| extend status = tostring(customDimensions.status)
| summarize runs = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), status
| render columnchart
content.title: Sync runs per day, by outcome

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.sync.runs"
| extend user = tostring(customDimensions.user_id), status = tostring(customDimensions.status), client = tostring(customDimensions.client)
| summarize started = sumif(valueSum, status == "started"), finished = sumif(valueSum, status == "finished"), incomplete = sumif(valueSum, status == "incomplete"), days_with_a_run = dcountif(bin(timestamp, 1d), status == "started"), last_run = max(timestamp), clients = make_set(client, 5) by user
| order by started desc
content.title: Sync frequency per user

content.query:
traces
| where message == "extraction stored"
| extend confidence = todouble(customDimensions.confidence)
| summarize reads = count() by bucket = round(bin(confidence, 0.1), 1)
| order by bucket asc
| render columnchart
content.title: Extraction confidence distribution (per read)

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.extraction.confidence"
| extend low = tostring(customDimensions.low_confidence)
| summarize reads = sum(valueCount), mean_confidence = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 3), low_confidence = sumif(valueCount, low == "True" or low == "true") by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Reads per day and mean confidence

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.lease.expiries"
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize expiries = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), outcome
| render columnchart
content.title: Lease expiries per day (reclaimed / failed)

content.query:
let reads = customMetrics | where name == "jolt.extraction.confidence" | summarize reads = sum(valueCount) by day = bin(timestamp, 1d);
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.lease.expiries"
| summarize expiries = sum(valueSum) by day = bin(timestamp, 1d)
| join kind=fullouter reads on day
| project day = coalesce(day, day1), expiries = coalesce(expiries, 0.0), reads = coalesce(reads, 0.0)
| extend rate = iff(reads > 0, round(expiries / reads, 3), real(null))
| order by day asc
content.title: Lease-expiry rate (expiries per stored read)

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.cosmos.request_charge"
| where tostring(customDimensions.surface) == "mcp"
| extend tool = tostring(customDimensions.operation)
| summarize RU = round(sum(valueSum), 1), calls = sum(valueCount), RU_per_call = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 2) by tool
| order by RU desc
content.title: RU per MCP tool

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.cosmos.request_charge"
| where tostring(customDimensions.surface) == "rest"
| extend route = tostring(customDimensions.operation)
| summarize RU = round(sum(valueSum), 1), requests = sum(valueCount), RU_per_request = round(sum(valueSum) / sum(valueCount), 2) by route
| order by RU desc
content.title: RU per REST route

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.cosmos.request_charge"
| extend surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface)
| summarize RU = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1h), surface
| render timechart
content.title: RU per hour, REST vs MCP

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.http.requests"
| extend cls = tostring(customDimensions.status_class)
| summarize total = sum(valueSum), e5xx = sumif(valueSum, cls == "5xx"), e4xx = sumif(valueSum, cls == "4xx") by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| project timestamp, rate_5xx = round(100.0 * e5xx / total, 2), rate_4xx = round(100.0 * e4xx / total, 2)
| render timechart
content.title: HTTP error rate (%) per hour

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.mcp.tool_calls"
| extend outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize calls = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1h), outcome
| render timechart
content.title: MCP tool outcomes per hour

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.http.requests"
| where tostring(customDimensions.status_class) == "5xx"
| extend route = tostring(customDimensions.route), method = tostring(customDimensions.method)
| summarize errors = sum(valueSum) by method, route
| order by errors desc
content.title: Failing routes (5xx)

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.rate_limited"
| extend surface = tostring(customDimensions.surface), scope = tostring(customDimensions.scope)
| summarize refused = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1h), series = strcat(surface, "/", scope)
| render timechart
content.title: Rate-limited requests (429) per hour

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize count() by type, outerMessage
| order by count_ desc
| take 20
content.title: Exceptions

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.maintenance.deleted"
| extend kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind)
| summarize deleted = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), kind
| render columnchart
content.title: Maintenance sweep deletions per day

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.model.calls"
| extend provider = tostring(customDimensions.provider), kind = tostring(customDimensions.kind), outcome = tostring(customDimensions.outcome)
| summarize calls = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), outcome
| render columnchart
content.title: Key-backed model calls per day (BE-11)

content.query:
customMetrics | where name == "jolt.model.tokens"
| extend provider = tostring(customDimensions.provider), direction = tostring(customDimensions.direction)
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 1d), provider, direction
| render columnchart
content.title: Tokens on users' keys per day (BE-11)
